description: Get user reviews of an app: star rating, date, text and app version; on Google Play also helpful votes and the developer's reply, on the App Store a review title. Use it to summarize what users like or complain about.

app_id.description: Android package name (e.g. com.instagram.android) or numeric App Store id (e.g. 389801252).

country.description: Optional two-letter ISO 3166 store country code. Defaults to US.

sort.description: Order: most_relevant (default), newest or rating (rating is Google Play only).

name: get_app_reviews
title: Get app reviews
